# Ripper

Internal ID: CrossbowRipper | Type: Crossbow | Source: Black forge | Usage: Ranged weapon | Wielding: Two-handed | Crafting Materials: Ashwood x15, Flametal x12, Morgen sinew x3, Bonemaw tooth x12 | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

The Ripper is the second crossbow crafted at a Black forge.
Like most Ashlands-tier weapons, the Ripper can be upgraded to one of the following three variants using gemstones:
• Wound Ripper (Bloodstone)
• Storm Ripper (Iolite)
• Root Ripper (Jade)
An upgraded Ripper will NOT keep its upgrade level when it is modified using gemstones.
